scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jev/shared && npm run build -w @jev/db && npm run build -w @jev/auth && concurrently -n web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @jev/web" "npm run dev -w @jev/api" "npm run dev -w @jev/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jev/shared && npm run build -w @jev/db && npm run build -w @jev/auth && npm run build -w @jev/api && npm run build -w @jev/worker && npm run build -w @jev/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jev/shared && npm run build -w @jev/db && npm run typecheck -w @jev/auth && npm run build -w @jev/auth && npm run typecheck -w @jev/api && npm run typecheck -w @jev/worker && npm run typecheck -w @jev/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jev/db && npm run test -w @jev/auth && npm run test -w @jev/api && npm run test -w @jev/worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
